360GS extension: v0.3c13 six-face 90-degree cubemap projection experiment.
Source-position holdout and train-fit diagnostics group six cubemap faces per original 360 source frame.
SH degree 1 and the v0.3c12 browser-safe Gaussian density schedule are retained.
The cubemap is a compatibility experiment before a possible direct equirectangular WebGPU rasterizer.
wasm-opt disabled in CI because --converge exceeded hosted-runner time limits.
